// Each philosopher takes the lower-numbered of its two forks first, so
// the table cannot deadlock.

use default
use Ghul.Coroutines

let philosophers =
    ["Aristotle", "Kant", "Spinoza", "Marx", "Russell"]

let meals = 2
let random = System.Random(42)

let forks = philosophers |> map(_ => MUTEX()) |> collect_list()

dine(name: string, seat: int) -> COROUTINE is
    let left = seat
    let right = (seat + 1) % forks.count
    let lower = if left < right then left else right fi
    let higher = if left < right then right else left fi

    for _ in 1::meals do
        write_line("{name} is thinking")
        await sleep(random.next(1, 4) * 250)

        await forks[lower].acquire()
        await forks[higher].acquire()

        write_line("{name} eats with forks {lower} and {higher}")
        await sleep(random.next(1, 4) * 250)

        forks[higher].release()
        forks[lower].release()

        write_line("{name} puts the forks down")
    od
si

for seat in 0..philosophers.count do
    dine(philosophers[seat], seat)
od

run()

let forks = philosophers |> map(_ => MUTEX()) |> collect_list()

dine(name: string, seat: int) -> COROUTINE is
    let left = seat
    let right = (seat + 1) % forks.count
    let lower = if left < right then left else right fi
    let higher = if left < right then right else left fi

    for _ in 1::meals do
        write_line("{name} is thinking")
        await sleep(random.next(1, 4) * 250)

        await forks[lower].acquire()
        await forks[higher].acquire()

        write_line("{name} eats with forks {lower} and {higher}")
        await sleep(random.next(1, 4) * 250)

        forks[higher].release()
        forks[lower].release()

        write_line("{name} puts the forks down")
    od

for seat in 0..philosophers.count do
    dine(philosophers[seat], seat)
od
